anchor_sentence.description: the exact sentence whose reading changes, copied verbatim from the article

development.description: what happened and how it changes what the passage establishes

quote.description: verbatim words from the source that settle the point

date.description: publication or access date, YYYY-MM-DD when known

reason.description: why this clears the threshold; record any doubt here

reason_to_leave.description: the strongest reason an editor might reasonably leave the passage as it is

other_affected_passages.description: exact sentences elsewhere whose reading also changes; empty for a single-sentence qualification

abstention_note.description: if no findings, what you looked for and why nothing cleared the threshold; otherwise empty
